record.description: LiveChat is a real-time customer service software designed to enhance online sales and support for businesses. Operating globally, it provides a web-based platform, along with desktop and mobile applications, to connect companies with their website visitors efficiently. With over 30,000 clients, including notable brands, LiveChat facilitates engaging customer interactions, aiding in purchase decisions, and expediting the sales process. The service is priced competitively, with various plans available to accommodate different business needs.
